root_cause.text: The index `htype` derived from untrusted network data via `(ule_sndu_type & 0x00FF)` can take the value 255, which is out-of-bounds for the 255-element extension handler arrays (valid indices 0-254), causing an out-of-bounds read and potential execution of an arbitrary function pointer.
root_cause.evidence: CVE description states: "the index htype is derived from network-controlled data as (ule_sndu_type & 0x00FF), giving a range of 0-255. When htype equals 255, an out-of-bounds read occurs on the function pointer table"; The patch adds a bounds check: `if (htype >= ARRAY_SIZE(ule_mandatory_ext_handlers)) return -1;`.
